title: Stuart coins
html_source: Deasy’s “Stuart coins” are relics of a sorry period in Ireland’s history: its invasion in 1688 by King James II of England. In 1689-90, after securing the allegiance of many of the Irish, James issued a series of new coins that were minted from base metals like copper and brass and debased the existing Irish currency
